name: othello-bot
description: Root shim: Vercel runs `vercel-build` from here if its Root Directory is the repo root. See docs/deploy.md.

scripts.vercel-build: rm -rf web/api/othello_rl && cp -r src/othello_rl web/api/othello_rl && npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
